cases.reply: Yes — cancelling three days ahead gives you more than 48 hours of notice, which qualifies for a full refund of the amount you paid.

Once a refund is approved, it goes back to your original payment method, and card refunds usually show up within 5 to 10 business days depending on your bank. If you paid with Apple Pay or Google Pay, it follows the timeline of the linked card. We can't send a refund to a different card or to a bank account.

Yes — changes made less than 24 hours before the appointment carry a $25 late change fee, since the professional has already planned their route. If you move it at least 24 hours ahead, rescheduling is free. Keep in mind you can reschedule a booking up to two times.

A deep cleaning is $240 for homes up to 1,500 square feet, so a small apartment would fall at that price. It includes inside cabinets, baseboards, the oven, fridge interior, and window sills, and all supplies are included. If you'd like us to use your own products, just mention it in the booking notes.
I couldn't find that in our help center. Would you like me to connect you with a person?

Yes, we do serve Denver, Colorado, along with Austin, Dallas, Houston, and San Antonio. Within each city we cover addresses up to 25 miles from downtown, so it's worth entering your ZIP code in the app to confirm your address is covered before booking.

Yes — our plumbers (and electricians) must hold a valid state license, which we verify before they're activated. Every professional also passes identity verification and a criminal background check before their first job, repeated annually, plus a skills assessment and safety training.

You can request account deletion in the app under Account Settings, then Privacy. You'll need to cancel any upcoming bookings first, and your account is deleted within 30 days. Note that we're required to keep payment and invoice records for seven years for tax purposes.

On Sundays, our human support agents are available from 9 AM to 5 PM Central Time. Just ask the assistant to connect you with a person, and during those hours an agent usually replies within 15 minutes.

We don't offer pest control — it's outside the services we handle, along with roofing, gas line work, and mold remediation. I'm sorry we can't help with that one, but we're glad to assist with anything else on our list.
